items.title: Document analysis with OCR
items.text: AI-based analysis of documents for a B2B software product, built on the open-source Tesseract OCR engine.

items.title: Audio quality analysis for telephony
items.text: Automated, objective assessment of telephony audio quality with ViSQOL, a perceptual speech-quality metric.

items.title: Data extraction tools for games
items.text: AI-assisted tools that pull data out of game files and formats – groundwork for analysis, modding and preservation.

items.title: AI chatbot with an avatar
items.text: A self-hosted chatbot with its own personality and avatar, served through a NestJS REST API and connected to a streaming platform so different systems can talk to each other.

items.title: Dynamic stream schedule
items.text: A mobile-first web app for streamers: REST API plus Angular frontend, with Google Docs integration for planning.

items.title: Headless CMS websites
items.text: Several websites built with Strapi and Angular, with custom content types and authentication.
